known_gaps: primary_culture/religion/technology_group identifiers used in history files (e.g. 'misthalin', 'saradominist', 'gielinor_tech') are placeholders and do not yet have corresponding common/cultures, common/religions, or common/technology definition files. A full modifier/culture/religion dictionary cross-check is out of scope for this pass.

Only 3 of many possible Gielinor kingdoms are represented (Misthalin, Asgarnia, Kandarin). Kharidian Desert, Kourend, Tirannwn, Fremennik Province, Morytania, etc. are documented in provinces_ids but have no generated country/history/mission files yet.
